sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with C.T. (Sessions) Case No.78 of 2023, pending in the file of the learned Adhoc Additional Sessions Judge (FTSC), Jajpur, arising out of Jenapur P.S.
Case No.25 of 2023, for alleged commission of offences under Sections 376(1)/376(2)(n)/365 of IPC.
3.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Adhoc Additional District & Sessions Judge,(FTSC), Jajpur, by order dated 10.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 21.01.2023 and since charge-sheet has been filed on 18.03.2023, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is unwarranted.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

6. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.
7.

Considering the same and taking into account the filing of the charge sheet, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin over the matter.
